title: Achieving diversity in drug development programs for obesity
summary: Fortrea white paper on diversity in drug development programs focused on obesity research, diverse patient recruitment, clinical trial representation, inclusive trial design, and health equity in clinical research

"name": "Achieving Diversity in Drug Development Programs for Obesity | Fortrea White Paper",
"description": "This Fortrea white paper explores the importance of achieving diversity in drug development programs within obesity research and the strategies used to improve representation across clinical trials. The content focuses on diverse patient recruitment, inclusive clinical trial participation, health equity in clinical research, and addressing barriers that affect representation within obesity drug development studies. The white paper highlights challenges associated with underrepresented populations, patient engagement, trial accessibility, and developing inclusive trial design approaches that support broader participation across obesity clinical research programs. Fortrea discusses strategies designed to strengthen diversity in clinical trials, improve representation across patient populations, and support equitable participation throughout obesity drug development research. By integrating diversity-focused recruitment approaches with inclusive research planning and patient-centered clinical trial strategies, the white paper provides insights into advancing representation and health equity within obesity clinical research programs."
